# `.ai-dlc/outputs/` — generated by the harness

Everything here is generated and git-ignored (except this README and the `.gitkeep` files).

| Directory | Content |
| --- | --- |
| `generated-tests/` | `subsystem-cases.json` / `.md` (from Excel), `subsystem/*.spec.ts` (Playwright tests written by skill 03), Playwright report |
| `reverse-docs/` | Design documents reverse-generated after the loop (skill 05) and `reverse-doc-facts.json` |
| `telemetry/` | `run-history.json` (every run / iteration / Copilot call / gate), `baseline.json`, per-run prompts, transcripts and usage |
| `reports/` | `binding-matrix.md`, `change-impact-map.md`, `final-quality-gate.md`, `unresolved-issues.md`, `qcd-comparison-report.{md,json}` |

To keep the results of a run (for example for the QCD comparison), copy the directory or commit it
on a separate branch.
